full_prompt_string: futuristic digital art, glowing brain or neural motif as central subject, circuit-board and neural network line patterns, cosmic sci-fi atmosphere, hyper-detailed 3D render quality, tech-mysticism fusion aesthetic, ultra sharp digital illustration, particle and spark accents, ethereal energy emanating from the subject
composition: centered symmetrical composition, medium to close-up framing, glowing subject as singular focal point, circuit lines or energy trails radiating outward, large dark negative space surrounding the subject
lighting: dramatic glow and bloom lighting, strong central light source emanating from the subject, neon-like luminescence, high contrast between dark background and glowing highlights, soft rim light
color_palette: deep black or navy background, vibrant neon accents shifting between electric blue, violet-purple, and warm orange-gold across pieces, high saturation glow, occasional teal or red variant
negative_prompt: text, logo, watermark, cluttered typography, busy background elements unrelated to the central subject
